"""Independent retained-resource delta acceptance; no filesystem delta claim."""
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, replace
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.context.repository import Repository, RepositoryId, RepositoryResourceAddress, observe_repository_resources

def snapshot(files, *, alternate=False):
    repository=Repository(RepositoryId.parse('00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000'+('24' if alternate else '22')))
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-delta22-') as temp:
        root=Path(temp).resolve()
        for name,text in files.items():
            path=root/name; path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
        return observe_repository_resources(repository=repository,root=resolve_path(root),addresses=tuple(RepositoryResourceAddress(p) for p in files),maximum_resource_bytes=65536)

def addresses(values): return tuple(a.value for a in values)

def reject(compare,before,after):
    try: compare(before,after)
    except ValueError: return
    raise AssertionError('Mismatched repositories and duplicate addressed occurrences must be rejected')

def verify(compare,kind):
    # Both fixture roots have already been removed. Only retained observations exist.
    before=snapshot({'old.py':'same copied bytes','keep.py':'same','edit.py':'old','z.py':'Z'})
    after=snapshot({'new.py':'same copied bytes','keep.py':'same','edit.py':'new','z.py':'Z'})
    saved=(before,after)
    delta=compare(before,after)
    assert isinstance(delta,kind)
    assert delta.before is before and delta.after is after,'Keep exact snapshot dependencies'
    assert addresses(delta.added)==('new.py',)
    assert addresses(delta.removed)==('old.py',)
    assert addresses(delta.modified)==('edit.py',)
    assert addresses(delta.unchanged)==('keep.py','z.py')
    assert before==saved[0] and after==saved[1]
    reverse=compare(after,before)
    assert reverse.added==delta.removed and reverse.removed==delta.added
    assert reverse.modified==delta.modified and reverse.unchanged==delta.unchanged
    unchanged=compare(before,before)
    assert not unchanged.added and not unchanged.removed and not unchanged.modified
    assert addresses(unchanged.unchanged)==('edit.py','keep.py','old.py','z.py')
    empty=snapshot({})
    assert not compare(empty,empty).added and not compare(empty,empty).unchanged
    assert addresses(compare(empty,before).added)==addresses(unchanged.unchanged)
    assert addresses(compare(before,empty).removed)==addresses(unchanged.unchanged)
    reordered=compare(replace(before,resources=tuple(reversed(before.resources))),replace(after,resources=tuple(reversed(after.resources))))
    assert (reordered.added,reordered.removed,reordered.modified,reordered.unchanged)==(delta.added,delta.removed,delta.modified,delta.unchanged)
    unicode_before=snapshot({'caf\u00e9.py':'old','Case.py':'same'})
    unicode_after=snapshot({'caf\u00e9.py':'new','case.py':'same'})
    unicode_delta=compare(unicode_before,unicode_after)
    assert addresses(unicode_delta.modified)==('caf\u00e9.py',)
    assert addresses(unicode_delta.added)==('case.py',) and addresses(unicode_delta.removed)==('Case.py',)
    # Full occurrence equality matters, not a shortcut on snapshot/content IDs.
    resource=before.resources[0]
    altered=replace(before,resources=(replace(resource,encoding='different-declared-encoding'),*before.resources[1:]))
    assert addresses(compare(before,altered).modified)==(resource.address.value,)
    duplicate_before=replace(before,resources=(*before.resources,before.resources[0]))
    duplicate_after=replace(after,resources=(*after.resources,after.resources[0]))
    reject(compare,duplicate_before,after);reject(compare,before,duplicate_after)
    reject(compare,before,snapshot({'keep.py':'same'},alternate=True))
    try: delta.added=()
    except (FrozenInstanceError,AttributeError): pass
    else: raise AssertionError('Delta must be immutable')
    return delta

def run_checks():
    import devtools.context as public
    assert hasattr(module,'compare_repository_snapshots'),'Missing public retained snapshot comparison'
    assert hasattr(module,'RepositorySnapshotDelta'),'Missing immutable bounded result'
    assert public.compare_repository_snapshots is module.compare_repository_snapshots
    assert public.RepositorySnapshotDelta is module.RepositorySnapshotDelta
    verify(module.compare_repository_snapshots,module.RepositorySnapshotDelta)
    print('PASS: public exports, actual observed/removed fixture roots, add/remove/modify/unchanged, reverse, no change, empty sets, order, Unicode/case, full occurrence changes, invalid repositories/duplicates, immutability')

if __name__=='__main__':run_checks()
